class Base {
  read(this: { need: string }) { return this.need; }
  static read(this: { extra: number }) { return this.extra; }
  typed<T>(this: T): T { return this; }
}
class Derived extends Base {
  need = 5;
  static extra = true;
  bracket() { return super["read"](); }
  dot() { return super.read(); }
  generic(): Base { return super["typed"](); }
  static bracket() { return super["read"](); }
  static dot() { return super.read(); }
}
const derived = new Derived();
console.log(derived.bracket(), derived.dot(), Derived.bracket(), Derived.dot(), derived.generic() === derived);
